statement: The system shall ensure that the audit records are protected from unauthorized deletion and modifications.
The system shall retain all archived records electronically for at least two years from the date of their receipt or creation.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted to the pharmacy within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent prescribers.
The system shall allow a prescriber to issue an electronic prescription for a patient.
The system shall perform real-time drug-drug interaction and allergy contraindication checking at the point of ordering.
The system shall allow the prescriber to cancel or change an existing electronic prescription.

The system shall ensure that the patient's demographic and observation data are recorded, including race, ethnicity, preferred language, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, name to use, pronouns, and date of birth.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted to the pharmacy without any alteration or truncation of data during transmission.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted only after an original prescription has not been printed.
The system shall ensure that controlled-substance prescriptions are signed by an authorized prescriber using two-factor authentication.
The system shall transmit the signed controlled-substance prescription to a pharmacy without the digital signature.
The system shall generate an audit record for each action related to the issuance of a controlled-substance prescription.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in its original electronic form and not converted to another form during transmission.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted only if it has been signed by an authorized prescriber.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted to the designated pharmacy only.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in a format that can be read and processed by the pharmacy application.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in a secure manner to prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall ensure that the controlled-substance prescription is transmitted in a manner that complies with all applicable regulations and standards.
